responsibility: Manages register elimination during LRA, replacing eliminable registers such as frame or argument pointers with their chosen hard-register bases plus dynamically changing offsets. It maintains the elimination table and current mapping, tracks stack-pointer-relative offset changes across the function, updates or finalizes RTL before and during constraint passes, and forces reprocessing of insns whose addressing validity changes as stack layout evolves. This is the LRA component responsible for devirtualizing eliminable hard registers at the right time.
